Subject: Revolver Ocelot in MGSV TPP, mature man aged about 40, silver swept-back shoulder-length hair and a small silver mustache, NO hat, NO eyepatch. Long dark brown leather duster coat reaching knees, pale tan shearling collar, distinctive red neck scarf, red gloves, dark trousers, black knee-high riding boots, leather belt and two compact holstered revolvers. Row2 MOVE: four clearly different walking phases to the RIGHT, alternating steps and coat folds. Row3 INTERACT: raise one gloved hand to shoulder radio, listen, lower hand, give a compact forward tactical gesture. Row4 REACT: notice sound, turn eyes while remaining right-facing, small upper-body flinch, recover stance; no death, no firing, no blood.
